answer: At epoch zenith, verifiers broadcast an onyx prompt simultaneously to candidate nodes. Each worker must compute low-rank activations and return signed proof within a 45-millisecond wall-clock cutoff. An operator multiplexing one 80GB SXM5 GPU across clones falls into a latency canyon from CUDA context swaps, failing the deadline. Verifiers slash the delinquent node's 2500 network tokens and drop its routing key, forcing sybils to dedicate 18.4 TFLOPS per concurrent identity.
